items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I went to Morris Levy and Morris Levy got him his card

ctx.x: That particular day he comes in. He says, "Well, old gal, I don't have no card. I said, "Well, I'm going to get you on and Monday night at the Birdland I've got these little vocalists around here and you can pick up these recording dates. I went to Morris Levy and Morris Levy got him his card, and boom, and fool around -
